## agent-ml-research
ML research experiment management tools

attachment.content:
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate Figure 2: Depth Fingerprinting Framework Overview. v4

Three-phase horizontal pipeline with embedded DDR feature response bars.
Fixed: ρ label overlap, color legend stacked, LOGO title position.
"""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import os

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
})

C_DRIFT  = '#D35400'
C_STAT   = '#2471A3'
C_INTER  = '#6C8C3C'
C_BG1    = '#FDF6F0'
C_BG2    = '#F0F4F8'
C_BG3    = '#F4F0F8'
C_ARROW  = '#555555'

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7.2, 4.2))
ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])
ax.set_xlim(0, 10.8)
ax.set_ylim(0, 5.7)
ax.axis('off')

# ═══════════════ PHASE BACKGROUNDS ═══════════════
phases = [
    (0.05, 2.50, C_BG1, '(a) Generation Chain'),
    (2.75, 4.65, C_BG2, '(b) Feature Extraction & Differential Depth Response'),
    (7.60, 3.10, C_BG3, '(c) Depth Classification'),
]
for x0, w, color, title in phases:
    bg = FancyBboxPatch((x0, 0.15), w, 5.30, boxstyle='round,pad=0.08',
                        facecolor=color, edgecolor='#BBBBBB', linewidth=0.8,
                        zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(bg)
    ax.text(x0 + w/2, 5.25, title, ha='center', va='top',
            fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color='#333333', zorder=1)

# ═══════════════ (a) GENERATION CHAIN ═══════════════
chain_x = 0.30
chain_y0 = 4.55
dy = -0.58

labels_a = ['gen-0  (human)', 'gen-1', 'gen-2', 'gen-3', 'gen-4']
colors_a = ['#27AE60', '#3498DB', '#E67E22', '#E74C3C', '#9B59B6']

for i, (lab, col) in enumerate(zip(labels_a, colors_a)):
    y = chain_y0 + i * dy
    box = FancyBboxPatch((chain_x, y - 0.20), 1.65, 0.40,
                         boxstyle='round,pad=0.06',
                         facecolor=col, edgecolor='white',
                         alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.8, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    ax.text(chain_x + 0.825, y, lab, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=7.5, color='white', fontweight='bold', zorder=3)
    if i < 4:
        mid = y + dy / 2
        ax.annotate('', xy=(chain_x + 0.825, y + dy + 0.22),
                    xytext=(chain_x + 0.825, y - 0.22),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_ARROW,
                                   lw=1.0, shrinkA=1, shrinkB=1), zorder=2)
        ax.text(chain_x + 1.82, mid, 'G(·)', ha='left', va='center',
                fontsize=6.5, color='#777777', style='italic', zorder=3)
    ax.text(chain_x - 0.08, y, f'd={i}', ha='right', va='center',
            fontsize=6.5, color='#888888', zorder=3)

for j, line in enumerate(['8 generators · 5 families',
                           '0.6B – 8B parameters',
                           'τ = 0.7,  top-p = 0.9',
                           'max 256 new tokens']):
    ax.text(chain_x + 0.825, 0.80 - j * 0.24, line,
            ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5, color='#555555', zorder=3)

# ═══════════════ A → B arrow ═══════════════
ax.annotate('', xy=(2.95, 2.90), xytext=(2.60, 2.90),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_ARROW, lw=1.8), zorder=5)

# ═══════════════ (b) FEATURE EXTRACTION + DDR ═══════════════
fx = 3.00

# Reference model
ref_box = FancyBboxPatch((fx + 0.20, 4.45), 2.50, 0.38,
                         boxstyle='round,pad=0.06',
                         facecolor='#ECF0F1', edgecolor='#95A5A6',
                         linewidth=1.0, zorder=2)
ax.add_patch(ref_box)
ax.text(fx + 1.45, 4.64, 'Pythia-410M (reference)', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color='#2C3E50', zorder=3)

ax.annotate('', xy=(fx + 1.45, 4.10), xytext=(fx + 1.45, 4.32),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_ARROW, lw=1.0), zorder=2)
ax.text(fx + 1.45, 4.02, 'per-token NLL:  $\\ell_1, \\ell_2, \\ldots, \\ell_n$',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#555555', zorder=3)
ax.annotate('', xy=(fx + 1.45, 3.62), xytext=(fx + 1.45, 3.84),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_ARROW, lw=1.0), zorder=2)

# Feature table
features = [
    ('hapax_ratio *',  -0.63, C_DRIFT),
    ('TTR *',          -0.61, C_DRIFT),
    ('entropy_mean',   -0.60, C_DRIFT),
    ('entropy_min',    -0.41, C_INTER),
    ('entropy_std',    -0.17, C_INTER),
    ('entropy_max',     0.08, C_STAT),
    ('tail_decay',      0.04, C_STAT),
]

table_y_top = 3.48
row_h = 0.34
name_x = fx + 0.20

# Bar geometry: ρ=0 line placed with room for labels on both sides
bar_zero_x = 5.80
bar_scale = 1.8   # reduced to avoid overlap

# ρ=0 reference line
ax.plot([bar_zero_x, bar_zero_x],
        [table_y_top + 0.15, table_y_top - 6 * row_h - 0.15],
        color='#BBBBBB', linewidth=0.7, zorder=1)
ax.text(bar_zero_x, table_y_top + 0.22, 'ρ = 0', ha='center', va='bottom',
        fontsize=5.5, color='#999999', zorder=3)

for i, (name, rho, color) in enumerate(features):
    y = table_y_top - i * row_h

    # Feature name
    ax.text(name_x, y, name, ha='left', va='center',
            fontsize=6.8, fontfamily='monospace', color='#333333', zorder=3)

    # Bar
    bar_w = abs(rho) * bar_scale
    bx = bar_zero_x - bar_w if rho < 0 else bar_zero_x
    bar = FancyBboxPatch((bx, y - 0.09), bar_w, 0.18,
                         boxstyle='round,pad=0.02',
                         facecolor=color, alpha=0.70,
                         edgecolor='none', zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(bar)

    # ρ text outside bar
    rho_str = f'{rho:+.2f}'
    if rho < 0:
        ax.text(bx - 0.06, y, rho_str, ha='right', va='center',
                fontsize=6.5, color=color, fontweight='bold', zorder=3)
    else:
        ax.text(bx + bar_w + 0.06, y, rho_str, ha='left', va='center',
                fontsize=6.5, color=color, fontweight='bold', zorder=3)

# Group separators
for sep_idx in [2.5, 4.5]:
    y = table_y_top - sep_idx * row_h
    ax.plot([name_x, bar_zero_x + 0.50], [y, y],
            color='#CCCCCC', linewidth=0.5, linestyle='--', zorder=1)

# Group labels (right of bars, stacked vertically within each group)
glabel_x = bar_zero_x + 0.55
group_defs = [
    (0, 2, C_DRIFT, 'Drifting'),
    (3, 4, C_INTER, 'Intermediate'),
    (5, 6, C_STAT,  'Stationary'),
]
for si, ei, gc, gl in group_defs:
    y_mid = (table_y_top - si * row_h + table_y_top - ei * row_h) / 2
    # Small colored square + label
    sq = FancyBboxPatch((glabel_x, y_mid - 0.07), 0.14, 0.14,
                        boxstyle='round,pad=0.01',
                        facecolor=gc, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='none', zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(sq)
    ax.text(glabel_x + 0.20, y_mid, gl, ha='left', va='center',
            fontsize=6, color=gc, fontweight='bold', zorder=3)

# Footnote
ax.text(name_x, table_y_top - 7.1 * row_h + 0.12,
        '* surface features (no reference model needed)',
        ha='left', va='center', fontsize=5.5, color='#888888',
        style='italic', zorder=3)

# ═══════════════ B → C arrow ═══════════════
ax.annotate('', xy=(7.75, 2.90), xytext=(7.40, 2.90),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_ARROW, lw=1.8), zorder=5)
ax.text(7.57, 3.08, '7 features', ha='center', va='bottom',
        fontsize=6, color=C_ARROW, zorder=5)

# ═══════════════ (c) DEPTH CLASSIFICATION ═══════════════
cx = 7.80

# XGBoost box
xgb = FancyBboxPatch((cx, 4.45), 2.65, 0.38,
                     boxstyle='round,pad=0.06',
                     facecolor='#ECF0F1', edgecolor='#95A5A6',
                     linewidth=1.0, zorder=2)
ax.add_patch(xgb)
ax.text(cx + 1.325, 4.64, 'XGBoost Classifier', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold', color='#2C3E50', zorder=3)

ax.annotate('', xy=(cx + 1.325, 4.05), xytext=(cx + 1.325, 4.32),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_ARROW, lw=1.0), zorder=2)

# Output class boxes
out_y = 3.85
for j, (lab, col) in enumerate([('gen-0', '#27AE60'),
                                  ('gen-1', '#3498DB'),
                                  ('gen-2+', '#E67E22')]):
    bx = cx + 0.05 + j * 0.87
    box = FancyBboxPatch((bx, out_y - 0.20), 0.78, 0.38,
                         boxstyle='round,pad=0.05',
                         facecolor=col, edgecolor='white',
                         alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.8, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    ax.text(bx + 0.39, out_y, lab, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=8, color='white', fontweight='bold', zorder=3)

# Results
results = [
    ('LOGO (8 generators)', '', True),
    ('  Binary F1 (1 vs 2+)', '0.694', False),
    ('  3-class macro F1', '0.762', False),
    ('', '', False),
    ('Cross-model (5 generators)', '', True),
    ('  Binary F1 (1 vs 2+)', '0.830', False),
    ('  3-class macro F1', '0.809', False),
]
ry = 3.25
for k, (lab, val, hdr) in enumerate(results):
    y = ry - k * 0.25
    if hdr:
        ax.text(cx + 0.05, y, lab, ha='left', va='center',
                fontsize=6.5, color='#444444', fontweight='bold', zorder=3)
    elif lab:
        ax.text(cx + 0.05, y, lab, ha='left', va='center',
                fontsize=6.5, color='#555555', zorder=3)
        ax.text(cx + 2.55, y, val, ha='right', va='center',
                fontsize=7.5, color='#2C3E50', fontweight='bold', zorder=3)

# LOGO mini-diagram
logo_x = cx + 0.05
logo_y = 0.85
ax.text(logo_x + 1.0, logo_y + 0.58, 'Leave-One-Generator-Out CV',
        ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=6.0, color='#555555', fontweight='bold', zorder=3)

gen_short = ['Py-2.8', 'Py-1B', 'OLMo', 'Q-1.7',
             'Q-0.6', 'Q-8B', 'Llama', 'Mistral']
for g in range(8):
    gx = logo_x + (g % 4) * 0.55
    gy = logo_y + 0.12 - (g // 4) * 0.36
    is_test = (g == 7)
    fc = '#E74C3C' if is_test else '#D5D8DC'
    box = FancyBboxPatch((gx, gy - 0.12), 0.48, 0.24,
                         boxstyle='round,pad=0.03',
                         facecolor=fc, edgecolor='white',
                         alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.5, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    ax.text(gx + 0.24, gy, gen_short[g], ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=4.5, color='white' if is_test else '#444444',
            fontweight='bold' if is_test else 'normal', zorder=3)

# LOGO legend
ax.plot([logo_x + 2.28, logo_x + 2.43], [logo_y + 0.12, logo_y + 0.12],
        color='#D5D8DC', linewidth=5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=2)
ax.text(logo_x + 2.48, logo_y + 0.12, 'train (7)', ha='left', va='center',
        fontsize=5.5, color='#777777', zorder=3)
ax.plot([logo_x + 2.28, logo_x + 2.43], [logo_y - 0.12, logo_y - 0.12],
        color='#E74C3C', linewidth=5, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=2)
ax.text(logo_x + 2.48, logo_y - 0.12, 'test (1)', ha='left', va='center',
        fontsize=5.5, color='#E74C3C', zorder=3)

# ═══════════════ Save ═══════════════
outdir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
for fmt in ['pdf', 'png']:
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, f'fig2_framework.{fmt}'), dpi=300)
    print(f'Saved fig2_framework.{fmt}')
plt.close()

322	def compute_reference_features(texts, tokenizer, model, device, batch_size=8):
323	    results = []
324	    for start in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
325	        batch_texts = texts[start:start + batch_size]
326	        encodings = tokenizer(
327	            batch_texts, return_tensors="pt", padding=True,
328	            truncation=True, max_length=512,
329	        ).to(device)
330	
331	        with torch.no_grad():
332	            logits = model(**encodings).logits
333	
334	        for i in range(len(batch_texts)):
335	            mask = encodings["attention_mask"][i].bool()
336	            seq_len = mask.sum().item()
337	            if seq_len < 2:
338	                results.append({k: 0.0 for k in
339	                    ["entropy_mean", "entropy_std", "entropy_min", "entropy_max", "tail_decay"]})
340	                continue
341	
342	            token_logits = logits[i, :seq_len - 1, :]
343	            log_probs = torch.log_softmax(token_logits, dim=-1)
344	            probs = torch.exp(log_probs)
345	            entropy = -(probs * log_probs).sum(dim=-1)
346	            entropy_np = entropy.float().cpu().numpy()
347	
348	            avg_log_probs = log_probs.float().mean(dim=0)
349	            sorted_lp, _ = torch.sort(avg_log_probs, descending=True)
350	            sorted_lp_np = sorted_lp.cpu().numpy()
351	            vocab_size = sorted_lp_np.shape[0]
352	            hi = min(1000, vocab_size)
353	            lo = min(100, hi)
354	            if hi - lo >= 2:
355	                x = np.arange(lo, hi, dtype=np.float64)
356	                y = sorted_lp_np[lo:hi].astype(np.float64)
357	                coeffs = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
358	                tail_decay = float(coeffs[0])
359	            else:
360	                tail_decay = 0.0
361	
362	            results.append({
363	                "entropy_mean": float(np.mean(entropy_np)),
364	                "entropy_std": float(np.std(entropy_np)),
365	                "entropy_min": float(np.min(entropy_np)),
366	                "entropy_max": float(np.max(entropy_np)),
367	                "tail_decay": tail_decay,
368	            })
369	
370	        if (start + batch_size) % 200 == 0 or start + batch_size >= len(texts):
371	            print(f"  Ref features: {min(start + batch_size, len(texts))}/{len(texts)}")
372	
373	    return results

459	def run_cv(X, y, n_splits=5):
460	    """Run stratified k-fold CV, return per-fold F1 scores and OOF predictions."""
461	    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
462	    fold_f1s = []
463	    oof_preds = np.zeros_like(y)
464	
465	    for fold, (train_idx, test_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
466	        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
467	        clf.fit(X[train_idx], y[train_idx])
468	        preds = clf.predict(X[test_idx])
469	        f1 = f1_score(y[test_idx], preds, average="macro", zero_division=0)
470	        fold_f1s.append(f1)
471	        oof_preds[test_idx] = preds
472	
473	    return fold_f1s, oof_preds

"""
cross_model_chains.py — Cross-model chain experiment (plan_007)

RQ3: Do depth fingerprints persist when each generation step uses a different model?
Cross-model chains randomly select a generator at each depth, simulating realistic
recursive generation where different LLMs contribute at different steps.

Pipeline:
  Phase 1 (generate): Depth-by-depth generation with random model selection.
    At each depth, group seeds by assigned generator, load one model at a time.
  Phase 2 (extract):  7-feature extraction using Pythia-410M reference model.
  Phase 3 (evaluate): 5-fold CV + comparison with single-model baselines.

Input:  data/wiki_seed_1000.jsonl
Output: data/cross-model-chains/generations_shard{X}.jsonl
        data/cross-model-chains/chain_assignments_shard{X}.json
        data/cross-model-chains/features.csv
        results/cross_model_chains_results.json

Usage:
  # Parallel generation on 2 GPUs:
  python cross_model_chains.py --phase generate --shard-id 0 --num-shards 2 --device cuda:2
  python cross_model_chains.py --phase generate --shard-id 1 --num-shards 2 --device cuda:3
  # After both complete:
  python cross_model_chains.py --phase extract --device cuda:2
  python cross_model_chains.py --phase evaluate
"""

import argparse
import gc
import json
import os
import random
import signal
import time
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
from tqdm import tqdm
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
from scipy.stats import kruskal
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score, classification_report, confusion_matrix
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

signal.signal(signal.SIGHUP, signal.SIG_IGN)

SEED = 42
MAX_DEPTH = 4
NUM_DEPTHS = MAX_DEPTH + 1
MAX_TOKENS = 256
PROMPT_TOKENS = 128
MAX_NEW_TOKENS = 256

GENERATOR_POOL = {
    "pythia-2.8b": "/root/autodl-tmp/models/pythia-2.8b/models--EleutherAI--pythia-2.8b/snapshots/2a259cdd96a4beb1cdf467512e3904197345f6a9",
    "pythia-1b": "/root/autodl-tmp/models/pythia-1b/EleutherAI/pythia-1b",
    "olmo-2-1b": "/root/autodl-tmp/models/olmo-2-1b-hf/allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B",
    "qwen3-0.6b": "/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen/Qwen3-0___6B-Base",
    "qwen3-1.7b": "/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen/Qwen3-1___7B-Base",
}

REFERENCE_MODEL = "/root/autodl-tmp/models/pythia-410m/models--EleutherAI--pythia-410m/snapshots/9879c9b5f8bea9051dcb0e68dff21493d67e9d4f"

DATA_DIR = Path("/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data")
RESULTS_DIR = Path("/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/results")
OUTPUT_DIR = DATA_DIR / "cross-model-chains"

FEATURES = ["entropy_mean", "entropy_std", "entropy_min", "entropy_max",
            "tail_decay", "ttr", "hapax_ratio"]

CLASS_MAP = {0: 0, 1: 1, 2: 2, 3: 2, 4: 2}
XGB_PARAMS = dict(n_estimators=200, max_depth=6, learning_rate=0.1,
                  random_state=SEED, eval_metric="mlogloss",
                  use_label_encoder=False)


# ================================================================
# Shared utilities
# ================================================================

def load_seeds(path, max_tokens=256):
    """Load seeds, truncate with pythia-2.8b tokenizer for consistency."""
    tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
        GENERATOR_POOL["pythia-2.8b"], local_files_only=True)
    seeds = []
    with open(path, "r") as f:
        for line_num, line in enumerate(f):
            item = json.loads(line)
            text = item.get("text", "")
            if len(text.strip()) < 100:
                continue
            token_ids = tok.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)[:max_tokens]
            if len(token_ids) < 64:
                continue
            seeds.append({"seed_id": line_num, "text": tok.decode(token_ids)})
    print(f"Loaded {len(seeds)} seeds from {path}")
    return seeds


def assign_generators(seed_ids, max_depth, generator_names, rng_seed=42):
    """Pre-assign a random generator for each (seed_id, depth) pair.
    Deterministic: same rng_seed always produces same assignments."""
    rng = random.Random(rng_seed)
    assignments = {}
    for sid in sorted(seed_ids):
        for depth in range(1, max_depth + 1):
            assignments[(sid, depth)] = rng.choice(generator_names)
    return assignments


def generate_continuation(model, tokenizer, text, device,
                          max_new_tokens=256, prompt_tokens=128):
    input_ids = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
    if len(input_ids) == 0:
        return ""
    input_ids = input_ids[-prompt_tokens:]
    input_tensor = torch.tensor([input_ids], device=device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        output = model.generate(
            input_tensor,
            max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
            temperature=0.7,
            top_p=0.9,
            do_sample=True,
            pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id,
        )
    new_tokens = output[0][len(input_ids):]
    return tokenizer.decode(new_tokens, skip_special_tokens=True)


def load_generator(model_name, model_path, device):
    print(f"Loading generator {model_name} from {model_path} on {device}")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(
        model_path, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=True)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        model_path, local_files_only=True, torch_dtype=torch.float16,
        trust_remote_code=True,
    ).to(device).eval()
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token
    print(f"  Loaded {model_name}, vocab={model.config.vocab_size}")
    return model, tokenizer


def unload_model(model, tokenizer):
    del model, tokenizer
    gc.collect()
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()


# ================================================================
# Phase 1: Generate cross-model chains
# ================================================================

def load_existing_records(output_path):
    records = {}
    if not os.path.exists(output_path):
        return records
    with open(output_path, "r") as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            try:
                rec = json.loads(line)
                records[(rec["seed_id"], rec["depth"])] = rec
            except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError):
                pass
    return records


def phase_generate(args):
    torch.manual_seed(SEED)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed(SEED)
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    seed_path = DATA_DIR / "wiki_seed_1000.jsonl"
    all_seeds = load_seeds(str(seed_path))

    total = len(all_seeds)
    shard_size = total // args.num_shards
    start = args.shard_id * shard_size
    end = start + shard_size if args.shard_id < args.num_shards - 1 else total
    seeds = all_seeds[start:end]
    print(f"Shard {args.shard_id}/{args.num_shards}: seeds [{start}:{end}] ({len(seeds)} seeds)")

    if args.dry_run:
        seeds = seeds[:3]
        print(f"[DRY-RUN] Processing only {len(seeds)} seeds")

    seed_ids = [s["seed_id"] for s in seeds]
    generator_names = list(GENERATOR_POOL.keys())
    assignments = assign_generators(seed_ids, MAX_DEPTH, generator_names, rng_seed=SEED)

    assign_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"chain_assignments_shard{args.shard_id}.json"
    assign_serializable = {f"{sid}_{d}": gen for (sid, d), gen in assignments.items()}
    with open(str(assign_path), "w") as f:
        json.dump(assign_serializable, f, indent=2)
    print(f"Assignments saved to {assign_path}")

    output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / f"generations_shard{args.shard_id}.jsonl"
    existing = load_existing_records(str(output_path))
    print(f"Found {len(existing)} existing records for resume")

    # Build current_texts from seeds + existing records
    current_texts = {}
    for s in seeds:
        current_texts[s["seed_id"]] = s["text"]

    # Replay existing records to get latest text per seed
    for (sid, d), rec in sorted(existing.items(), key=lambda x: (x[0][0], x[0][1])):
        if sid in current_texts:
            current_texts[sid] = rec["text"]

    t0 = time.time()

    # Write depth=0 records
    with open(str(output_path), "a") as f:
        for s in seeds:
            sid = s["seed_id"]
            if (sid, 0) in existing:
                continue
            rec = {
                "id": sid * NUM_DEPTHS,
                "depth": 0,
                "text": s["text"],
                "seed_id": sid,
                "token_count": len(s["text"].split()),
                "generator_at_depth": "wikipedia",
                "chain_generators": ["wikipedia"],
            }
            f.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            f.flush()
            existing[(sid, 0)] = rec

    # Depth-by-depth generation
    for depth in range(1, NUM_DEPTHS):
        todo_seeds = [s for s in seeds if (s["seed_id"], depth) not in existing]
        if not todo_seeds:
            print(f"Depth {depth}: all {len(seeds)} seeds complete, skipping")
            continue

        # Check prerequisite: all todo seeds must have depth-1 completed
        missing_prev = [s for s in todo_seeds if (s["seed_id"], depth - 1) not in existing]
        if missing_prev:
            print(f"WARNING: {len(missing_prev)} seeds missing depth {depth-1}, skipping them")
            todo_seeds = [s for s in todo_seeds if s not in missing_prev]

        gen_groups = defaultdict(list)
        for s in todo_seeds:
            gen_name = assignments[(s["seed_id"], depth)]
            gen_groups[gen_name].append(s)

        print(f"\nDepth {depth}: {len(todo_seeds)} seeds across {len(gen_groups)} generators")
        for gn, gs in gen_groups.items():
            print(f"  {gn}: {len(gs)} seeds")

        for gen_name, gen_seeds in gen_groups.items():
            model_path = GENERATOR_POOL[gen_name]
            model, tokenizer = load_generator(gen_name, model_path, args.device)

            skipped = 0
            with open(str(output_path), "a") as f:
                for s in tqdm(gen_seeds, desc=f"d{depth}/{gen_name}"):
                    sid = s["seed_id"]
                    prev_text = current_texts.get(sid, "")

                    if len(prev_text.strip()) < 10:
                        print(f"WARNING: seed {sid} depth {depth}: input too short, skipping")
                        skipped += 1
                        continue

                    continuation = generate_continuation(
                        model, tokenizer, prev_text, args.device,
                        max_new_tokens=MAX_NEW_TOKENS, prompt_tokens=PROMPT_TOKENS,
                    )
                    if not continuation or len(continuation.strip()) == 0:
                        print(f"WARNING: seed {sid} depth {depth}: empty output, skipping")
                        skipped += 1
                        continue

                    chain_gens = ["wikipedia"]
                    for dd in range(1, depth + 1):
                        chain_gens.append(assignments[(sid, dd)])

                    cont_tokens = tokenizer.encode(continuation, add_special_tokens=False)
                    rec = {
                        "id": sid * NUM_DEPTHS + depth,
                        "depth": depth,
                        "text": continuation,
                        "seed_id": sid,
                        "token_count": len(cont_tokens),
                        "generator_at_depth": gen_name,
                        "chain_generators": chain_gens,
                    }
                    f.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
                    f.flush()

                    current_texts[sid] = continuation
                    existing[(sid, depth)] = rec

            if skipped:
                print(f"  {gen_name}: skipped {skipped} seeds")
            unload_model(model, tokenizer)

        elapsed = time.time() - t0
        done_at_depth = sum(1 for s in seeds if (s["seed_id"], depth) in existing)
        print(f"Depth {depth} done: {done_at_depth}/{len(seeds)} seeds, {elapsed:.0f}s elapsed")

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    print(f"\nGeneration complete. {len(existing)} total records in {elapsed:.1f}s")


# ================================================================
# Phase 2: Feature extraction
# ================================================================

def compute_reference_features(texts, tokenizer, model, device, batch_size=8):
    results = []
    for start in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
        batch_texts = texts[start:start + batch_size]
        encodings = tokenizer(
            batch_texts, return_tensors="pt", padding=True,
            truncation=True, max_length=512,
        ).to(device)

        with torch.no_grad():
            logits = model(**encodings).logits

        for i in range(len(batch_texts)):
            mask = encodings["attention_mask"][i].bool()
            seq_len = mask.sum().item()
            if seq_len < 2:
                results.append({k: 0.0 for k in
                    ["entropy_mean", "entropy_std", "entropy_min", "entropy_max", "tail_decay"]})
                continue

            token_logits = logits[i, :seq_len - 1, :]
            log_probs = torch.log_softmax(token_logits, dim=-1)
            probs = torch.exp(log_probs)
            entropy = -(probs * log_probs).sum(dim=-1)
            entropy_np = entropy.float().cpu().numpy()

            avg_log_probs = log_probs.float().mean(dim=0)
            sorted_lp, _ = torch.sort(avg_log_probs, descending=True)
            sorted_lp_np = sorted_lp.cpu().numpy()
            vocab_size = sorted_lp_np.shape[0]
            hi = min(1000, vocab_size)
            lo = min(100, hi)
            if hi - lo >= 2:
                x = np.arange(lo, hi, dtype=np.float64)
                y = sorted_lp_np[lo:hi].astype(np.float64)
                coeffs = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)
                tail_decay = float(coeffs[0])
            else:
                tail_decay = 0.0

            results.append({
                "entropy_mean": float(np.mean(entropy_np)),
                "entropy_std": float(np.std(entropy_np)),
                "entropy_min": float(np.min(entropy_np)),
                "entropy_max": float(np.max(entropy_np)),
                "tail_decay": tail_decay,
            })

        if (start + batch_size) % 200 == 0 or start + batch_size >= len(texts):
            print(f"  Ref features: {min(start + batch_size, len(texts))}/{len(texts)}")

    return results


def compute_surface_features(texts):
    results = []
    for text in texts:
        words = text.lower().split()
        n_tokens = len(words)
        if n_tokens == 0:
            results.append({"ttr": 0.0, "hapax_ratio": 0.0})
            continue
        counter = Counter(words)
        results.append({
            "ttr": len(counter) / n_tokens,
            "hapax_ratio": sum(1 for c in counter.values() if c == 1) / n_tokens,
        })
    return results


def phase_extract(args):
    records = []
    for shard_file in sorted(OUTPUT_DIR.glob("generations_shard*.jsonl")):
        with open(shard_file) as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line:
                    records.append(json.loads(line))
    print(f"Loaded {len(records)} records from {OUTPUT_DIR}")

    if not records:
        print("ERROR: No records found. Run --phase generate first.")
        return

    texts = [r["text"] for r in records]

    print(f"Loading reference model from {REFERENCE_MODEL}")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(REFERENCE_MODEL, local_files_only=True)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        REFERENCE_MODEL, local_files_only=True, torch_dtype=torch.float16,
    ).to(args.device).eval()
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    ref_feats = compute_reference_features(
        texts, tokenizer, model, args.device, batch_size=args.batch_size)
    del model, tokenizer
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()

    surf_feats = compute_surface_features(texts)

    rows = []
    for rec, ref, surf in zip(records, ref_feats, surf_feats):
        rows.append({
            "id": rec["id"],
            "depth": rec["depth"],
            "seed_id": rec["seed_id"],
            "generator_at_depth": rec.get("generator_at_depth", ""),
            "chain_generators": json.dumps(rec.get("chain_generators", [])),
            **ref,
            **surf,
        })

    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    output_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "features.csv"
    df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    print(f"Features saved to {output_path}, shape={df.shape}")
    print(df.groupby("depth")[FEATURES].mean().round(4))


# ================================================================
# Phase 3: Evaluate
# ================================================================

class NumpyEncoder(json.JSONEncoder):
    def default(self, obj):
        if isinstance(obj, (np.bool_,)):
            return bool(obj)
        if isinstance(obj, (np.integer,)):
            return int(obj)
        if isinstance(obj, (np.floating,)):
            return float(obj)
        if isinstance(obj, np.ndarray):
            return obj.tolist()
        return super().default(obj)


def run_cv(X, y, n_splits=5):
    """Run stratified k-fold CV, return per-fold F1 scores and OOF predictions."""
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)
    fold_f1s = []
    oof_preds = np.zeros_like(y)

    for fold, (train_idx, test_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
        clf = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
        clf.fit(X[train_idx], y[train_idx])
        preds = clf.predict(X[test_idx])
        f1 = f1_score(y[test_idx], preds, average="macro", zero_division=0)
        fold_f1s.append(f1)
        oof_preds[test_idx] = preds

    return fold_f1s, oof_preds


def balance_dataset(df):
    gen0 = df[df["label"] == 0]
    gen1 = df[df["label"] == 1]
    gen2plus = df[df["label"] == 2]
    gen2_parts = []
    for d in [2, 3, 4]:
        subset = gen2plus[gen2plus["depth"] == d]
        n = min(333, len(subset))
        if n > 0:
            gen2_parts.append(subset.sample(n=n, random_state=SEED))
    gen2_sampled = pd.concat(gen2_parts, ignore_index=True) if gen2_parts else gen2plus
    min_size = min(len(gen0), len(gen1), len(gen2_sampled))
    return pd.concat([
        gen0.sample(n=min_size, random_state=SEED),
        gen1.sample(n=min_size, random_state=SEED),
        gen2_sampled.sample(n=min(min_size, len(gen2_sampled)), random_state=SEED),
    ], ignore_index=True)


def evaluate_single_model(feat_path):
    """Evaluate a single-model feature file with same pipeline."""
    df = pd.read_csv(feat_path)
    if "depth" not in df.columns or not all(f in df.columns for f in FEATURES):
        return None
    df["label"] = df["depth"].map(CLASS_MAP)
    balanced = balance_dataset(df)
    if len(balanced) < 30:
        return None
    X = balanced[FEATURES].values
    y = balanced["label"].values
    fold_f1s, _ = run_cv(X, y)
    return {
        "macro_f1_mean": round(float(np.mean(fold_f1s)), 4),
        "macro_f1_std": round(float(np.std(fold_f1s)), 4),
        "n_samples": len(balanced),
    }


def phase_evaluate(args):
    feat_path = OUTPUT_DIR / "features.csv"
    if not feat_path.exists():
        print("ERROR: Features not found. Run --phase extract first.")
        return

    df = pd.read_csv(feat_path)
    print(f"Loaded {len(df)} records, depths: {sorted(df['depth'].unique())}")

    df["label"] = df["depth"].map(CLASS_MAP)
    balanced = balance_dataset(df)
    print(f"Balanced: {len(balanced)} samples, {balanced['label'].value_counts().to_dict()}")

    X = balanced[FEATURES].values
    y = balanced["label"].values

    fold_f1s, oof_preds = run_cv(X, y)
    cross_model_f1 = np.mean(fold_f1s)
    cross_model_std = np.std(fold_f1s)
    print(f"\nCross-model chains: macro-F1 = {cross_model_f1:.4f} +/- {cross_model_std:.4f}")

    for i, f1 in enumerate(fold_f1s):
        print(f"  Fold {i}: {f1:.4f}")

    cm = confusion_matrix(y, oof_preds).tolist()
    report = classification_report(y, oof_preds, output_dict=True, zero_division=0)

    # Binary F1: gen-0 vs gen-2+
    mask_bin = np.isin(y, [0, 2])
    if mask_bin.sum() > 0:
        y_bt = (y[mask_bin] == 2).astype(int)
        y_bp = (oof_preds[mask_bin] == 2).astype(int)
        binary_f1 = f1_score(y_bt, y_bp, zero_division=0)
    else:
        binary_f1 = 0.0

    # Feature importance (full retrain)
    clf_full = XGBClassifier(**XGB_PARAMS)
    clf_full.fit(X, y)
    importance = dict(zip(FEATURES, [round(float(x), 4) for x in clf_full.feature_importances_]))

    # Generator diversity analysis
    if "chain_generators" in df.columns:
        chain_data = df[df["depth"] == MAX_DEPTH].copy()
        if len(chain_data) > 0:
            chain_data["chain_list"] = chain_data["chain_generators"].apply(
                lambda x: json.loads(x) if isinstance(x, str) else x)
            chain_data["n_unique_gens"] = chain_data["chain_list"].apply(
                lambda x: len(set(x[1:])))  # exclude "wikipedia"
            diversity_stats = {
                "mean_unique_generators": round(float(chain_data["n_unique_gens"].mean()), 2),
                "std_unique_generators": round(float(chain_data["n_unique_gens"].std()), 2),
                "distribution": chain_data["n_unique_gens"].value_counts().to_dict(),
            }
        else:
            diversity_stats = {}
    else:
        diversity_stats = {}

    # Single-model baselines
    print("\n--- Single-model baselines ---")
    single_model_results = {}
    candidate_paths = [
        ("pythia-2.8b", DATA_DIR / "pythia-2.8b-continuation" / "features.csv"),
        ("pythia-2.8b", DATA_DIR / "features_pythia-2.8b.csv"),
        ("pythia-1b", DATA_DIR / "pythia-1b" / "features.csv"),
        ("pythia-1b", DATA_DIR / "features_pythia-1b.csv"),
        ("olmo-2-1b", DATA_DIR / "olmo-2-1b" / "features.csv"),
        ("olmo-2-1b", DATA_DIR / "features_olmo-2-1b.csv"),
        ("qwen3-0.6b", DATA_DIR / "qwen3-0.6b" / "features.csv"),
        ("qwen3-0.6b", DATA_DIR / "features_qwen3-0.6b.csv"),
        ("qwen3-1.7b", DATA_DIR / "qwen3-1.7b" / "features.csv"),
        ("qwen3-1.7b", DATA_DIR / "features_qwen3-1.7b.csv"),
    ]
    for model_name, fpath in candidate_paths:
        if model_name in single_model_results:
            continue
        if not fpath.exists():
            continue
        result = evaluate_single_model(fpath)
        if result:
            single_model_results[model_name] = result
            print(f"  {model_name}: macro-F1 = {result['macro_f1_mean']:.4f} +/- {result['macro_f1_std']:.4f}")

    # Kruskal-Wallis tests
    stat_tests = []
    n_features = len(FEATURES)
    alpha_corrected = 0.05 / n_features
    groups = [balanced[balanced["label"] == lbl] for lbl in [0, 1, 2]]
    for feat in FEATURES:
        group_vals = [g[feat].dropna().values for g in groups]
        if any(len(g) < 2 for g in group_vals):
            stat_tests.append({"feature": feat, "H": None, "p": None, "sig": False})
            continue
        h_stat, p_val = kruskal(*group_vals)
        stat_tests.append({
            "feature": feat,
            "H": round(float(h_stat), 4),
            "p": float(p_val),
            "sig": p_val < alpha_corrected,
        })

    results = {
        "experiment": "cross_model_chains",
        "plan": "plan_007",
        "cross_model": {
            "macro_f1_mean": round(cross_model_f1, 4),
            "macro_f1_std": round(cross_model_std, 4),
            "binary_f1_gen0_vs_gen2plus": round(binary_f1, 4),
            "fold_f1s": [round(f, 4) for f in fold_f1s],
            "n_samples": len(balanced),
            "confusion_matrix": cm,
            "per_class": {
                cls_name: {
                    "precision": round(report[str(cls_label)]["precision"], 4),
                    "recall": round(report[str(cls_label)]["recall"], 4),
                    "f1": round(report[str(cls_label)]["f1-score"], 4),
                }
                for cls_label, cls_name in [(0, "gen-0"), (1, "gen-1"), (2, "gen-2+")]
                if str(cls_label) in report
            },
            "feature_importance": importance,
            "statistical_tests": stat_tests,
        },
        "generator_diversity": diversity_stats,
        "single_model_baselines": single_model_results,
        "generator_pool": list(GENERATOR_POOL.keys()),
    }

    RESULTS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    result_path = RESULTS_DIR / "cross_model_chains_results.json"
    with open(result_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2, cls=NumpyEncoder)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {result_path}")
    print(json.dumps(results, indent=2, cls=NumpyEncoder))


# ================================================================
# Main
# ================================================================

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Cross-model chain experiment (plan_007)")
    parser.add_argument("--phase", choices=["generate", "extract", "evaluate", "all"],
                        default="all")
    parser.add_argument("--device", default="cuda:2")
    parser.add_argument("--shard-id", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--num-shards", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=8)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.phase in ("generate", "all"):
        phase_generate(args)
    if args.phase in ("extract", "all"):
        phase_extract(args)
    if args.phase in ("evaluate", "all"):
        phase_evaluate(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
